events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas with eight chefs serving signature meals and hot samples.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot samples, plus a bodega-style scratch-off, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Food is while supplies last. No advance RSVP requirement is published; lines are expected.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan bodegas. Arrive early for the best chance at a meal.

events.what_it_is: A public KILIAN PARIS pop-up celebrating the fragrance brand's Cocktails Collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples; gifts with purchase are separate and while supplies last.
events.caveats: Exclusive gifts are tied to purchase and supplies; do not describe those gifts as unconditional freebies.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, noon–8 PM at Chelsea Triangle / 401 W 14th Street. Open to the public.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-inspired Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture education and sampling, and kakigori.
events.what_is_free: Tincture sampling and kakigori while supplies last; first 50 guests each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture.
events.caveats: Free items are limited; the first-50 mini tincture is not guaranteed after that threshold. Products are also for sale.
events.practical_notes: Friday has later opening hours than Saturday/Sunday. Use the date-specific occurrence below.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South Street, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: A Dunkin' sampling truck at Pier 17 serving seasonal drink samples and swag.
events.what_is_free: Samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin' swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples and swag are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 2:30–6 PM at Pier 17 in the Seaport. Open to the public.

events.event_name: Café Yaeji — Free Oatly Gochujang Lattes
events.what_it_is: A two-day immersive café inspired by Korean dabangs and Yaeji's creative world.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with Oatly Barista Edition.
events.caveats: Free drinks are subject to availability; no advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday Sept. 19–20, 9 AM–3 PM each day at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Union Square
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty Sephora pop-up with product try-ons, giveaways and prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Exclusive free gifts while supplies last and entry to prize opportunities; no purchase is necessary to attend and receive freebies.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Gift-with-purchase offers require the stated Sephora purchase, but attendance/freebies do not.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, noon–6 PM, on Broadway between East 13th and East 14th Streets by Sephora Union Square.

events.what_it_is: A launch pop-up for LONDONTOWN's Magnolia Bakery-inspired nail lakur collection.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 customers in line receive a free banana pudding dessert and LONDONTOWN lakur.
events.caveats: The free pudding and lakur are limited to the first 100 customers in line.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–1 PM at Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker Street. Open to the public.

events.what_it_is: A La Mer beauty activation pairing complimentary ice cream with a personalized Skin by La Mer experience.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary ice cream and a La Mer sample as part of the in-store skin experience.
events.caveats: Complimentary items are subject to availability. No advance RSVP requirement was found in the current listing.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2–6 PM at 504 Broadway in SoHo.
